test: none: open on SolidCraft's truck kernel (kernel work paused under tangency-labs/solidcraft#3992); geometry is the report's repro.json (a = 5.5, 6.0, 6.1, 6.5 and its two controls), reproduced on 0.29.0 with solidcraft-cli
summary: A cut failed for some sizes on SolidCraft's truck kernel after a join in which a slot's round end is tangent to a slab's faces (#11267). The report's tool (its repro.json, 0.26.0): on the XZ plane a circle of diameter 5.2 about (0, a) and a rectangle x 0..9, z a - 2.25..a + 2.25, extruded 10 towards +y (a new body); the same with the rectangle x -9..0, extruded 10 towards -y and joined; on the YZ plane a slot from (0, a) to (0, 16), 4.5 wide, extruded 10 both ways and joined; then the tool cut from a cylinder of diameter 16 and height 12.4. The slot is as wide as the slabs are tall, so its round bottom, a cylinder of radius 2.25 about the X axis at height a, touches the slabs' bottom faces z = a - 2.25 along the line y = 0 (by design: a cable enters through the slot). Replayed with solidcraft-cli 0.29.0 (truck): the slot's join is not exact and is retried with the tool moved ('Boolean retry: tool displacement 5.491811e-5 mm, rotation 2.000000e-6 rad'), and the cut then fails ('boolean Cut: the operation failed: no result') at a = 5.5, 6.1, 6.2 and 6.5, while 5.7, 5.9, 6.0, 6.3, 6.6 and 7.0 build, as in the report's table (a comment there has the same on 0.30.1); the report's two controls at a = 6.1, the slot 4.52 wide and the slabs without the circles, join without the retry and cut. Not fixed on truck: kernel work is paused (tangency-labs/solidcraft#3992), and the `pr` link is the SMLib kernel move (tangency-labs/solidcraft#4012). Each sketch's circle and rectangle extrude as one outline (on 0.29.0 the first slab is one body of 6 faces), and the cases build them so: the circle's arc outside the rectangle (radius 2.6, ends at x = +-sqrt(2.6^2 - 2.25^2), z = a +- 2.25) and the rectangle's three other sides, extruded on the XZ plane from y = 10 to 0 and from 0 to -10; the slot is two lines and two half circles on the YZ plane extruded from x = -10 to 10; the cylinder is a circle extruded 12.4. Volumes are exact integrals over z of the slices' areas: every slice of the tool is a union of axis-aligned rectangles (the circles |x| <= sqrt(2.6^2 - (z - a)^2), |y| <= 10; the slabs; the slot |x| <= 10, |y| <= sqrt(2.25^2 - (z - a)^2) below z = a and 2.25 above), its area by inclusion-exclusion and, for the cut, clipped to the cylinder's disc in closed form; integrated by Gauss-Legendre on each piece between the breakpoints with z = z0 + (z1 - z0)(1 - cos t)/2, as in 11005-tee-of-tubes-branch-bore-cut.json. 200 and 400 nodes and scipy's adaptive quadrature agree to 1e-10 mm^3, and a randomised QMC over the CSG (scrambled Sobol, 16 replicates of 2^21 points) lies within two of its standard errors (the largest 1.47); the truck results that build are within 0.08 mm^3 of these (meshed). Every case expects one lump, a manifold solid and its volume within 0.01 mm^3. Expected values are analytic; nothing comes from a commercial CAD product.
